title: De novo antioxidant peptide design via machine learning and DFT studies.
authors: Hesamzadeh, Parsa; Seif, Abdolvahab; Mahmoudzadeh, Kazem; Ganjali Koli, Mokhtar; Mostafazadeh, Amrollah; Nayeri, Kosar; Mirjafary, Zohreh; Saeidian, Hamid
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用机器学习和DFT设计抗氧化肽，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Antioxidant peptides (AOPs) are highly valued in food and pharmaceutical industries due to their significant role in human function. This study introduces a novel approach to identifying robust AOPs using a deep generative model based on sequence representation. Through filtration with a deep-learning classification model and subsequent clustering via the Butina cluster algorithm, twelve peptides (GP1-GP12) with potential antioxidant capacity were predicted. Density functional theory (DFT) calculations guided the selection of six peptides for synthesis and biological experiments. Molecular orbital representations revealed that the HOMO for these peptides is primarily localized on the indole segment, underscoring its pivotal role in antioxidant activity. All six synthesized peptides exhibited antioxidant activity in the DPPH assay, while the hydroxyl radical test showed suboptimal results. A hemolysis assay confirmed the non-hemolytic nature of the generated peptides. Additionally, an in silico investigation explored the potential inhibitory interaction between the peptides and the Keap1 protein. Analysis revealed that ligands GP3, GP4, and GP12 induced significant structural changes in proteins, affecting their stability and flexibility. These findings highlight the capability of machine learning approaches in generating novel antioxidant peptides.
abstract_zh: 抗氧化肽（AOPs）因其在人体功能中的重要作用而在食品和制药行业中备受重视。本研究提出了一种基于序列表示的深度生成模型来识别稳健抗氧化肽的新方法。通过深度学习分类模型的过滤及随后采用Butina聚类算法的聚类分析，预测了十二种具有潜在抗氧化能力的肽（GP1-GP12）。密度泛函理论（DFT）计算指导了六种肽的合成和生物学实验选择。分子轨道表示显示，这些肽的HOMO主要定位于吲哚片段，突显了其在抗氧化活性中的关键作用。所有六种合成肽在DPPH测定中均表现出抗氧化活性，而羟基自由基测试结果则不尽如人意。溶血实验确认了所生成肽的非溶血性质。此外，一项计算机模拟研究探讨了这些肽与Keap1蛋白之间潜在的抑制性相互作用。分析显示，配体GP3、GP4和GP12诱导了蛋白质显著的构象变化，影响其稳定性和柔韧性。这些发现凸显了机器学习方法在生成新型抗氧化肽方面的能力。
